subject: Modified execution goal v4: memory effort and measured hosted latency
reviewScope: Goal amendment only. Does not reopen original 17 tasks or accept unimplemented behavior.

scores.evidence: E1 covers shared domain/schema/backend, E2 covers SDK/client/provider/CLI/canonical consumers/docs, final qualification covers installed packages and affected modules.

Real hop positives/negatives, scopes/revocation/currentness, cycles/fanout/cancellation, bounds, pending/strict, default propagation, UI/CLI and every profile latency are explicit. Exact fixtures and sample sizes are ordinary execution choices.
Baseline, E1 contract/backend, E2 dependents, evidence-led repair, installed qualification and cleanup/audit are coherent packets; E1/E2 can split disjoint files after the contract.

Source paths, semantics, limits, compatibility and observed-outcome requirements are actionable. One harmless file pointer uses runtimeRuns.ts; actual run code is convex-dev/runs.ts and runtimeTranscriptSchema.ts.
Unchanged K29 baseline precedes source edits; shared backend contract precedes dependents; changed candidate build/install precedes real qualification; cleanup precedes final completion.

evidence.conclusion: Logical source/fact/message edges and exact scoped entities/relations have real stored provenance. Narrow adjacency/index additions are explicitly in scope. No invention of same-conversation edges or external graph prerequisite is required.
Current V1 quotas and V8 snapshot pinning require the planned versioned contract. V4 explicitly preserves old interpretation while introducing Normal defaults and one shared optional-entry budget.

Existing public recall has explicit 1-100 limits, canonical request binding and exact final delivery checks. E1 includes these seams and preserves binding/currentness/accounting rather than treating effort as authorization.

Current request/result fields do not yet carry effort. E1/E2 explicitly add and propagate shared validated fields, effective administrator-clamped policy and typed stop metadata; pending overflow/strict behavior must remain honest.

Fast2/3s, Normal4/6s default, High8/8s, Max no preset depth/30s are consistent. Max is bounded by useful context, pages, work, cost, cancellation and deadlines. 32768 is retained as a ceiling, not enlarged by this plan. Real depth isolation and first-visible model text targets are acceptance requirements, not already measured success.
